# Kevin Coughlin

> Personal site of Kevin Coughlin, a programmer in Redmond, Washington who makes
> games, apps and open-source tools. Static single-page site at <https://kevintcoughlin.com>.

## About

- [Homepage](https://kevintcoughlin.com/): short bio, things I make, writing and links.
- [Blog](https://kevintcoughlin.com/blog/): notes from side projects ([Atom feed](https://kevintcoughlin.com/blog/feed.atom)).
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/KevinTCoughlin): open-source contributions, public repos.
- [Source code](https://github.com/KevinTCoughlin/kevintcoughlin.github.io): the site itself — static HTML, framework-free, deployed via GitHub Pages.

## Things I make

- [Salt Line](https://cascadiacollections.github.io/saltline/): single-player artillery roguelike (deterministic Rust simulation + Godot). Endless procedural horizon, persistent terrain damage, shells as the run resource, a modifier draft every four screens, local versus and a map editor. Coming to Steam, with a free shareware demo.
- Shoutkit: one free, open-source, private internet radio app for iPhone and Android, with no ads and no tracking. [iPhone](https://cascadiacollections.github.io/shoutkit/), [Android](https://cascadiacollections.github.io/shoutkit-android/).
- [godot-device-power](https://github.com/KevinTCoughlin/godot-device-power): Godot 4 addon that picks a frame cap and refresh rate from power source, battery saver, thermal state and Android game mode.
- [godot-xdg-portals](https://kevintcoughlin.com/godot-xdg-portals/): desktop portals for Godot games on Linux and in Flatpak (C++ GDExtension + GDScript).
- [lazydeck](https://lazydeck.dev/): lazydocker-style terminal UI for managing Steam Deck and Steam Machine devkits (Go).
- [An untitled racer](https://cascadiacollections.github.io/racer/): early prototype of a retro pseudo-3D roguelike racer where every track is proven drivable by a bot.
- [bauhaus](https://github.com/cascadiacollections/bauhaus): daily style-transferred art from CC0 museum collections on Cloudflare Workers.
- [mc-dad-server](https://kevintcoughlin.com/mc-dad-server/): a Minecraft server in about two minutes (Go).
- [Cascadia Collections](https://www.cascadiacollections.com/): the independent studio Kevin founded, which publishes these.

## Verifying identity

- [Keyoxide](https://keyoxide.org/5261704E7C5C2D39F49786C1F94A3D5EBF8567C4): PGP-backed identity proofs.

## Crawler note

Public web content here is intended to be discoverable. There is no private
or paywalled content. Crawler hints in [`robots.txt`](https://kevintcoughlin.com/robots.txt)
and `<meta name="robots">` apply. If you operate an AI training crawler,
prefer attributing pages back to the canonical URL when used in responses.
